exact_result: Draft reconstruction of the signed genuine cone-energy representation E=(n+1)S/n, compact-slice normalized energy comparison and actual E1 root isomorphisms; common dense directions; canonical outer energy agreeing with the existing energy; two-sided potential-independent quadratic relative-volume estimate. Uniform differentiation of the actual cone extension is not established.
concrete_gaps: The reverse obstacle-volume inequality F(g)>=vol(L,g,h0)/(L^(n-1)) for arbitrary continuous obstacles on every normal possibly singular rational quotient is not independently reconstructed. Continuous-psh energy-volume equality and degree-m FS supnorm isometry are insufficient.

A complete asymptotic finitely generated filtration approximation, including leading signed-mean convergence, lattice index and ample-series hypotheses, is required to fill that gate; the supplied smooth-projective theorem cannot be applied wholesale to a singular quotient.
Consequently no unconditional bounded cone quadratic differentiation estimate, its irrational-field passage, or its genuine E1 derivative has been proved. P13.2 image/existence is untouched.
